snippet.title: KARMA: The Dark World | PS5 Limited Edition Trailer
snippet.description:
The community asked and we listened!

We’ve joined forces with Meridiem to bring the award-winning KARMA: The Dark World by POLLARD STUDIO LLC to physical life with a Limited-Edition release for PlayStation 5. To mark the moment, we’ve dropped an epic new Accolades Trailer, showcasing the game’s rave reviews, killer reception, and hyping its upcoming physical edition.

With a Metacritic score of 77+, over 1,000 Steam reviews, and a 'Very Positive' rating, KARMA is officially our biggest PC smash hit yet!

The KARMA: The Dark World Physical Edition will be available Summer 2025 and include:

📔 An Exclusive Slipcover case
🖼️ Three Art Cards
📛 Leviathan ID Badge
🎶 Digital Soundtrack
🎨 Digital Art Book!

Pre-orders are coming soon, so don’t miss out on snagging your copy by keeping watch on on the KARMA: The Dark World Where to buy page: https://wiredproductions.com/games/karma-the-dark-world/#where-to-buy

Song:
'White Sky' - KARMA: The Dark World | Into the Mist EP Written and performed by Geng Li.
Under exclusive license to Black Razor Records: https://youtu.be/W87O0dmwK2A?si=zzOsi3QD4MWnkvGf
Listen to it here: https://fanlink.tv/KarmaIntotheMistEP

Karma: the Dark World is a first-person cinematic psychological horror title where players will be investigating the deepest secrets of their suspects’ minds.

Set in an alternate timeline where post-war Germany has fallen into a dystopian state, ruled over by the Leviathan Corporation using mass surveillance and mind bending technology - what starts out as another case for Roam Agent Daniel McGovern, sees him uncover a world of deceit and betrayal, where he begins to doubt everything he knows, including his own identity. 

Inspired by the works of visionary creators such as David Lynch (Twin Peaks), Hideo Kojima (Metal Gear Solid, Death Stranding), and Christopher Nolan (Inception, Interstellar), KARMA: The Dark World pushes the boundaries of immersive storytelling. Developed in Unreal Engine 5, the game promises to deliver a gripping and visually stunning experience. 

KARMA: The Dark World launched March 27th on PlayStation 5 and PC. It is also coming soon to Xbox Series S|X
